text: Three-month Chinese Language Training Program for Beginners Courses: Basic Chinese; Chinese Listening; Oral Chinese Teaching Texts: Boya Chinese; Chinese Elementary Listening Course; Elementary Spoken Chinese Duration of Teaching: 20 classes per week; 15 weeks per term Fees Admission Fee: RMB 200 per person, paid at the time of application. Registration fee: RMB 200 per person, paid at the beginning of each school year. Miscellaneous Fee: RMB 4000 for the first year, and RMB 2500 for each following year. (Miscellaneous fee contains the fees for books, teaching materials, insurance, physical examination, residence permit, etc.) Accommodation Fee: for two-bed room is : 600 RMB / month (double room); 400 RMB / month (triple room) Notes: You could attend class during the mid-time of term and won't open classes alone except the amounts of students are large enough to have classes alone.
